preferredDevelopmentDirection: Retain 300 mm floor set-out; develop a wall-hung inlet carrier and independent local wall release. Do not adopt the broader border rule or the heavy complete tiled wall as the dry Study default.

floatingCourseComparator.scope: Lightly loaded conventional floating sand/cement screed with insulation firm enough for compaction.

groundSupport.held: Named bedding, separator, ordinary-course tolerance, above-glass support, uniform bearing and dry-to-wet edge.

installedInlet.scopedTo: Crouched floor-renewal phase only; no simultaneous inlet withdrawal. The new wall-hung assembly is an authored alternative, not an observed or qualified installed system.

mechanics.scope: Elastic isolated square arm comparison only; backplates, torsion, welds, anchor groups, wall, corrosion and complete capture remain unqualified.

removal: Park furniture using the bound occupied-room sequence; isolate only affected service work.
Undo the selected local moulding and anti-lift screws from the room; retain the moulding with the module identity.
For a hung cassette lift within its own pocket, then draw roomward; adjacent cassettes and cornice remain installed.
For a narrow edge face undo its roomward screws and draw straight forward without vertical lift.
Support the complete face on a protected first rest; fixed returns, independent service carriers and protective backing stay in place.
Refit on both hard lands, restore the local positive restraint, check flushness and record any damaged edge or lost retainer.
remaining: Complete panel, anchor, fixed air-plane collar and non-plastic constituent qualification; tile tray adhesion and restrained edge tests.
Hand/tool clearance, loaded release and first-rest access at each occupied wall; geometry is a local release proposal, not a carried-body simulation.
Floor substrate and depth; full module release, installed G1 support heights, remaining southeast strips and board placement.
Owner comparison with the fixed-room proposal after joined house integration. Wet-room waterproofing stays outside this dry Study tile variant.
